audit_summary.yolo_evaluator_status: Evaluation Scaffold / Interface Contract (NOT a real trained YOLO neural network experiment yet)
audit_summary.real_fpv_dataset_status: Real FPV Degradation Benchmark (samples/real_fpv_degraded.mp4 - 35% low-light, vignetting, Gaussian noise sigma=18, motion blur)
audit_summary.memory_leak_audit: PASSED (Continuous 60s benchmark processed 14,710 frames with 0% RSS memory growth and 67.1% RAM usage)
audit_summary.zero_dce_cpu_status: Prototype Neural Enhancer with unacceptable CPU latency (~1.2-2.0 s/frame) for live FPV at 720p without GPU acceleration

latency_definitions.end_to_end_latency_ms: Time from frame queue fetch + processing + HUD display render + video recorder write
latency_definitions.throughput_fps: Total output frames processed per second under bounded buffer queue drops
latency_definitions.fps_latency_discrepancy_explanation: FPS != 1000 / processing_latency because pipeline throughput includes VideoCapture thread I/O, queue lock contention, and OS thread context switching

degraded_fpv_benchmark_results.artifacts: Noise amplification in pitch-dark background regions
Slight texture smoothing in fine background foliage
Combined edge halos and noise stretch if unconstrained

engineering_answers.B_best_visual_improvement: Composite (Denoise -> CLAHE -> Sharpen) for multi-degradation FPV
engineering_answers.D_fewest_artifacts: Bilateral Denoise (smooths noise without edge halos)
engineering_answers.E_safest_for_downstream_cv: Bilateral Denoise (reduces false positive noise spikes without hallucinating false edges)
engineering_answers.F_is_yolo_experiment_valid: False - Current YOLO module is a scaffold/interface contract using contour heuristics, NOT a real trained YOLO deep neural network
engineering_answers.G_is_gpu_acceleration_justified: True - Zero-DCE on CPU takes ~2049 ms/frame; GPU FP16/ONNX acceleration is required to achieve <10 ms latency
engineering_answers.H_actual_bottleneck: Un-accelerated CPU PyTorch forward tensor conversions and multi-stage classical CPU loops at 720p resolution
engineering_answers.I_phase3_objective: Implement ONNX Runtime / TensorRT GPU acceleration for Zero-DCE neural models & integrate a real trained ONNX YOLOv8 object detector
